messages.subject: Interpret the values of Estimated effects derived from Multiple-QTL model results on a RIL Pop.
messages.subject_clean: Interpret the values of Estimated effects derived from Multiple-QTL model results on a RIL Pop.
messages.body_plain:
Dear Karl,
I have a RIL population and to did a QTL mapping. I used a Multiple-QTL model through R/qtl package through R via this command line

Res_QTL <- fitqtl(SHD, qtl=qtl, formula=y~Q1+Q2+Q3*Q4, + dropone=FALSE, get.ests=TRUE)

I just want to know how should I interpret the values of "Estimated effects" ? can it be regarded as an additive effect since the population i used is RIL?

Thank you in advanced,
Best
Amir
